question.text: Maurya VC Fund (Cat I AIF): Committed Capital INR 500 crore. Commitment period ends at end of Year 3. PPM states: 'Management Fee = 2.0% on Committed Capital during the commitment period; 1.5% on INVESTED CAPITAL (at cost, net of write-offs) thereafter.' At start of Year 4, Invested Capital at cost = INR 360 crore (no write-offs). What is the Year 4 management fee (EXCLUDING GST)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Post the commitment period, the base SWITCHES. Year 4 base = INR 360 crore (invested capital, no write-offs). Year 4 fee = 1.5% x INR 360 crore = INR 5.40 crore. The workbook (pp.90, 112) supports management fees on committed capital during the commitment period and, thereafter, on actual invested capital or AUM. The Trap: A keeps 2.0% on INR 500 crore (ignored the step-down in both rate and base); B applies 2.0% to INR 360 crore (wrong rate); D applies 1.5% to a fabricated INR 600 crore figure. Note: After the commitment period, BOTH the fee rate AND the base typically step down — the rate drops and the base moves from committed capital to invested capital (net of write-offs).
